stories.title: Three new members officially join the Duval County School Board; new leadership elected
stories.summary: Donovan Bradley, Rhodesia Butler and Lindsey Denmark were sworn in Tuesday night as the board is faced with increasing criticism regarding anti-Muslim speech.

stories.title: Jacksonville mother says daughter’s broken arm went undiagnosed for a week in juvenile detention
stories.summary: Two agencies are investigating after a mother says her daughter's arm was broken inside the Duval Regional Juvenile Detention Center.

stories.title: 'Pay my rent or my JEA bill': JEA customers protest high bills and demand relief
stories.summary: JEA customers protested high utility bills in Jacksonville, with some saying rising costs are forcing families to choose between essential expenses.

stories.title: Mayor Deegan orders halt of unauthorized coal ash at Keystone site
stories.summary: If the order is not followed, the City of Jacksonville may seek enforcement in court, which will include civil penalties of up to $2,000 per day.

stories.title: One person dead after pedestrian-involved crash on Blanding Boulevard
stories.summary: The crash near Jefferson Avenue involved a pedestrian and a semi-truck, according to the Florida Highway Patrol.

stories.title: Crash on Arlington Expressway results in death, multiple injuries
stories.summary: A Jacksonville Fire and Rescue Department spokesperson said three injured adults were taken from the crash site near Townsend Boulevard.

stories.title: Jacksonville police officer arrested for alleged battery in Nassau County
stories.summary: 46-year-old Jonathan Vest, an officer with the Jacksonville Sheriff's Office since 2016, has been reassigned from his position pending the outcome of the case.

stories.title: Nights of Lights Guide | What to know about parking, free shuttles, road closures and more in 2026
stories.summary: St. Augustine's Nights of Lights returns on Nov. 21, transforming the historic city with dazzling holiday light displays.

stories.title: ‘He was a treasure’: Former students remember Paterson Elementary Principal John O’Brian
stories.summary: Former students say the longtime Clay County educator helped build their confidence, inspire their careers and shape the lives they lead today.

stories.title: Don't panic. Tests are planned today for the Nationwide Emergency Alert System
stories.summary: On Nov. 17, radio and television broadcasters nationwide will interrupt normal TV and radio programming to relay a test message. The test is scheduled for 2:20 p.m.

stories.title: Baymeadows Road crash involving three vehicles leaves 2 dead: FHP
stories.summary: Florida Highway Patrol investigators say the crash happened when a 17-year-old hit a car that was attempting to turn onto Baymeadows Circle East.

stories.title: 'A weight lifted': Mother speaks after man pleads guilty in fatal Burger King shooting
stories.summary: Dawud Burritt has pleaded guilty to second-degree murder and attempted first-degree murder in the 2025 shooting of 18-year-old Matthew Jackson at a Burger King.
